> you insist on that (illogical, though official) point, so be it.

It sounds like you're missing something in the official rule.
There is no "triggering during 3". The whole diablerie (steps
1-5) is one unit. Anything that triggers "when a vampire is
burned" or "when a vampire is diablerized" triggers on the
diablerie as a whole and, naturally, takes effect afterwards.
Anything that needs to be played *before* burning/diablerie is,
conversely, played before step 1.

Basically, the ordering of the steps only matters within the
diablerie itself, so that blood and equipment don't get lost
before the vampire is burned. To the entire "outside world"
all that's visible is: diablerie occurs, a vampire disappears,
the diablerist has more blood, equipment, possibly a skill
card, and might have had a blood hunt referendum called.

From that other message:

> No, Nakova damage, Etrius'soul gem, Husamettin abilities and the like
> (effects triggering upon the burning of a vamp) would occour
> *during" step 3, that is, the *actual* burning, not after step 5 (that is,
> pretty after
> the burning).

But the *result* of Nakova damage would be exactly the same,
since you wouldn't be able to play Freak Drive between the
Amaranth and step 3 even if you allowed diablerie to be
divisible, would you? And honestly I don't think you *should*
be able to.

Josh

can see the logic even if he doesn't like losing RotBR
functionality

> The "burning" effects triggers on 3, but those can't interrupt
> the diablerie, so they occours after just after the diablerie is over....
> or i'm wrong ? (LSJ ?)

It "triggers" on diablerie. The single-unit thing called diablerie.
Since it cannot be played before the diablerie (nothing is burned
then), it is played after.

An effect to be played/used/activated before the burning is
played/used/activated before the diablerie. An effect to be
played/used/activated after the burning (or "trigger by"
the burning) is played/used/activated after the diablerie
(or "triggered by" the diablerie).
